# Normalization by internal standards (IS)

## Internal standards (ISs) 

```{r}
#| child: !expr file.path(chapters_dir, "process-internal-stds.qmd")
```

## Normalization by ISs

The dataset is normalized using the provided ISs. The user can opt to choose between 2 normalization methods: 
- "Closest RT" method, whereby the peak area intensity of each feature/chemical is corrected with that of the closest IS in RT. Target classes of compounds can be specified.
- "LOESS" method, whereby the peak area intensity of each feature/chemical is corrected by a LOESS model curve built using all the IS spanning across the entire chromatographic RT.

```{r}
#| purl: true
# Find the range of RT values
all_rts <- util$retention_time(pre_norm_se)
overall_rt_range <- range(all_rts)
targetted_rt_range <- range(all_rts[util$is_targeted_feature(pre_norm_se)])
rt <- range(all_rts[util$is_internal_std(pre_norm_se)])
```

The retention time (RT) range of the dataset is between `r overall_rt_range[1]` and `r overall_rt_range[2]` min.
The RT range of the targeted chemicals to be quantified is from `r targetted_rt_range[1]` to `r targetted_rt_range[2]` min.
The RT range of the internal standards is from `r range(rt)[1]` to `r range(rt)[2]` min.

```{r}
#| purl: true
norm_se <- to_report[["normalized"]]
```

```{r}
#| label: blank-filtering
if (to_report$blank_filter) {
  cat("

### Blank filtering

Features are filtered based on the blank samples after normalization and before blank subtraction.
A feature is kept if:
    
*   The maximum peak area in the samples is greater than",
    to_report$blank_filter_factor, "times the average peak area in the blanks, OR
*   The average peak area in the samples is greater than", 
    to_report$blank_filter_factor, "times the average peak area in the blanks.
\n\n")

  se_before_blank_filter <- to_report[["normalized"]]
  se_after_blank_filter <- to_report[["after blank filtering"]]
  before_n <- nrow(se_before_blank_filter)
  after_n <- sum(SumExp::row_df(se_after_blank_filter)[["blank_filtered"]])
  removed_n <- before_n - after_n

  cat("
Number of features filtered based on blank:

*   Number of features before filtering:", before_n, "
*   Number of features removed:", removed_n, "
*   Number of features remaining:", after_n, "\n")
}
```

### Blank subtraction

After data normalization, peak areas are blank corrected by subtracting the corresponding feature average peak area detected in the blanks (negative values set to zero).
Blank subtraction is applied to all samples in the dataset except for the calibration standards per batch.

```{r}
#| label: target_mode
if (IS_TARGET_MODE) {
  cat("\n\n# Calibration\n\n")
  cat("\nThe calibration is performed per batch.\n\n")
  qmd <- "process-calibration-llox_from_llox_signal.qmd"
  cat(knitr::knit_child(file.path(chapters_dir, qmd), quiet = TRUE))
  # Stop here if the calibration is not performed
  if (all(sapply(lst_proc, is.null))) {
    cat("\n\n# No calibration\n\n")
    cat("Because it is not possible to perform calibration with the provided data.\n\n")
  } else {
    qmd <- "process-calibration-curves.qmd"
    cat(knitr::knit_child(file.path(chapters_dir, qmd), quiet = TRUE))
    cat("\n\n# Concentration\n\n")
    cat(knitr::knit_child(file.path(chapters_dir, "_process-concentration.qmd"), quiet = TRUE))
  }
}
```
